serialization.hash_scope: Exact raw file bytes including the final LF.

temporal_claim.meaning: This seal fixes the hypothesis and experiment criteria before dedicated prior-art review and before implementation code. It does not itself prove novelty, correctness or utility.

immutability_rule: The sealed target must never be rewritten after prior-art search or experimental results. Corrections, prior-art findings and implementations must be additive artifacts with independent hashes and explicit lineage.
canonical_seed_role: Deterministic ordering and experiment precommitment anchor; not evidence of randomness quality, novelty or correctness.
claim_boundary: The seal proves only the byte-identical existence and declared chronology of the artifact. It does not prove that the hypothesis is new, true, useful, energy-saving or product-ready.
